Source: https://github.com/svich/maxmetal at commit 919805d (2026-10-31), `src/translate.c` and `include/maxmetal/maxmetal.h`, unmodified. License in LICENSE (MIT); `licenses/Ryujinx.txt` is the license of the Ryujinx decoders its instruction bit layouts come from.
Use: the host translates the shaders the split missed (`dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py`) at run time with it, on the Mac and the iPhone / iPad: `dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_maxmetal.m` (the request and the reflection), `nvn_maxmetal_lib.c` (compiles `src/translate.c` into the host by the NVN layer's wildcard). Its NVN mode writes the binding layout of the offline chain's libraries (`dm/gfx/nvn/dmsh_abi.h`). Updating it: copy the two files, then change `MAXMETAL_REV` in `nvn_maxmetal.m` (the device's cached translations of the old one are translated again).
